integrity.claim_scope: Exact real-parameter two-cap profile and sharp fixed-removed-volume minima/maxima with equality conditions.
integrity.computational_cross_checks: 11 exact rational difference-body reconstructions; 66 exact derivative and identity samples.
integrity.proof_basis: Explicit polytope support facet areas and monotonic one-variable optimization.

scientific_limitations: Restricted to tetrahedra with two nonoverlapping homothetic vertex cuts by planes parallel to opposite facets.
The two-cut sharp fixed-volume allocation theorem is not a global mixed-volume extremal theorem.
The general anti-blocking mixed-volume projection identity precedes this result; only the fixed-volume two-cut optimizer, threshold and plateau are proposed as new.
Priority relative to older literature under alternate terminology remains provisional; independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: Sharp cap-allocation phase transition for the three-dimensional Godbersen ratio
